ceu: ✦ The trine between Jupiter and Saturn

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.
